## What's new
- **Login box instead of "Run as different user".** Double-click the exe or shortcut and a login box opens. Log in with your admin account and the app starts again as that account, just like "Run as different user". **Run as (your Windows user) instead** skips it. Starting the app with "Run as different user" still works and skips the box.
- **Keep me logged in.** Saves the login in Windows Credential Manager (encrypted by Windows for your Windows account) and starts the app as that account straight away next time. Hold **Shift** while starting the app to see the box again. A saved password that stops working is deleted instead of being retried.
- **Domain Admins dot.** The header shows the account the app runs as, with a **green dot** when it is in Domain Admins (nested groups count) and a **red dot** when it isn't. The old check for `-admin` at the end of the user name is gone.
- **c$ Share** opens the Windows logged-in user's profile on the left (found through the profile list, so folders like `d.smith.CORP` work too), instead of the app's account name with `-admin` removed.

## Upgrading from v5.4.0
- Extract the new zip over the old folder, or into a new one.
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.
- Shortcuts that use "Run as different user" keep working; a plain shortcut now shows the login box.
- When the app runs from a file share, the admin account needs read access to that folder.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.5.0-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` and log in with your admin account.

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.
